description: ERC-8283 function index schema, paired with the ERC-7730 v3 draft. This is the mutable '-next' draft: it changes frequently and without notice, and consumers MUST NOT rely on its stability — see ERC-8283 'Index file schemas and versioning'.

entry.title: Function index entry
entry.description: One function's or message type's descriptor and attestations.

descriptorHash.title: Function descriptor hash
descriptorHash.description: The ERC-8176 descriptor hash of the self-contained, flattened function descriptor this entry names.

descriptorUris.title: Function descriptor URIs
descriptorUris.description: Absolute URIs the function descriptor JSON file can be fetched from, using the identical scheme that was used to successfully fetch this function index itself — see 'Index file schemas and versioning' in ERC-8283.

attestations.title: Function attestations
attestations.description: Every attestation rendition of this function descriptor, at most one per attestationFormatId. MAY be empty while a corrected descriptor awaits attestation.

attestationId.title: Attestation ID
attestationId.description: The attester-chosen identifier of this attestation. Not registered on-chain for a function index entry — see ERC-8283 'Manifests' section (Function Indexes).

attestationFormatId.title: Attestation format ID
attestationFormatId.description: keccak256("erc7730.attestation.<format>"), namespacing the shape of this attestation artifact.

uris.title: Attestation blob URIs
uris.description: Absolute URIs the signed attestation blob can be fetched from, using the identical scheme that was used to successfully fetch this function index itself.

version.title: Schema version
version.description: Identical to the ERC-7730 descriptor schema version this function index is paired with. A consumer MUST treat a function index declaring a version it does not implement as invalid.

methods.title: Contract-call entries
methods.description: Maps each raw 4-byte ABI function selector to its function index entry. MAY be empty for a function index with no contract-call functions.

messages.title: EIP-712 message entries
messages.description: Maps each EIP-712 message type hash (the typeHash of its primary type) to its function index entry. MAY be empty for a function index with no EIP-712 messages.
